[element-tbx-subjectField]
=== `<tbx:subjectField>` Subject Field (TBX)

A field of special knowledge, such as _information technology_ or _leather industry_. Specifying a subject field can help to clarify the field in which a particular term or concept is used.

#### Usage/Remarks
The subject field is specified at the <<element-tbx-langSet,`<tbx:langSet>`>> level.

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-script,`@script`>>
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-tbx-langSet,`<tbx:langSet>`>>
#### Description

Text, numbers, or special characters
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  %TBX.subjectField; 
                        (#PCDATA)                                    >
....

#### Tagged Sample

##### Clarifying the definition
[source,xml]
....
<tbx:termEntry id="ISO10241-1.a213.313">
  <tbx:langSet xml:lang="en">
    <tbx:subjectField>linear actuator</tbx:subjectField>
    <tbx:definition>condition where the valve drifts from the set position</tbx:definition>
    <tbx:tig>
      <tbx:term id="a213.313-1">backdriving</tbx:term>
      <tbx:partOfSpeech value="noun"/>
    </tbx:tig>
  </tbx:langSet>
</tbx:termEntry>
....
